verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these five benefits of listening to the teaching.

verses.pali: Assutaṁ suṇāti, sutaṁ pariyodāpeti, kaṅkhaṁ vitarati, diṭṭhiṁ ujuṁ karoti, cittamassa pasīdati.
verses.english: You learn new things, clarify what you’ve learned, get over uncertainty, correct your views, and inspire confidence in your mind.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ānisaṁsā dhammassavane”ti.
verses.english: These are the five benefits of listening to the teaching.”
